text_block_list.text: Hah… hah…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Tonight, just for this very moment,
with our arms intertwined,
the one reflected in her eyes will be me.
And the one reflected in my eyes will be
her… I won't let anyone take that away from
me.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Ha, haha… you really are Chiyono O-san's
number one, dancing with her like that.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you came to watch too,
Nature!
Did you see those two dancing?
They were totally amazing!
text_block_list.name: Dorowa Committee Member

text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
I saw them dance.
More like they showed off for us.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Like,
I think everyone in the committee thought
the Teio-McQueen pair would snag first for
sure,
but we've got a surprise contender now!
text_block_list.name: Dorowa Committee Member

text_block_list.text:
Wait,
speak of the devil!
They're gonna go toe-to-toe!
text_block_list.name: Dorowa Committee Member

text_block_list.text: What's going on here, huh? Before you two started dancing, we were the stars of the show, y'know!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
And is that why you two are purposefully
dancing next to us?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Surely you expected a direct confrontation too,
Ardan-san?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text: Still, we're not…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: We're not gonna lose!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Wow, things are heating up with those two
pairs!
Sheesh… their movements just keep on getting
sharper and sharper.
text_block_list.name: Dorowa Committee Member

text_block_list.text:
Nature, don'tcha feel some pride, too? I mean,
Teio-san's your classmate,
right?
Since you've always run in the same races,
you can brag about that!
text_block_list.name: Dorowa Committee Member

text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
that's right… She feels so far away.
It's like she was born already standing in
the spotlight.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
If I had to say,
I'm more like a background extra who just
watches her from shadows.
That kind of thing.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
(Right,
she and I aren't on the same stage.
Someone like me could never be Teio's
partner.)
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
(That's why I resigned myself to my fate
and stuck to the committee side of things,
just watching over everyone else. But…)
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Even if throughout our lives we find that
we were not eachother's number one,
for just this one special night,
we were able to become eachother's
irreplaceable partners.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
(… Even if I can't be her "fated number one",
if I could just be a special partner to
her…)
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: Huh? Nature?
text_block_list.name: Dorowa Committee Member

text_block_list.text: If I could… just…!
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
